

Reordering is wrong: post-order over *outs* puts dependents before their dependencies. Need a proper downstream closure + deps-first topo order, recomputing only cells whose deps changed:

<tool_call>
<function=edit>
<parameter=new>
func (c *cell) propagate() {
	// Collect the downstream closure of c.
	closure := map[*cell]bool{}
	stack := []*cell{c}
	for len(stack) > 0 {
		x := stack[len(stack)-1]
		stack = stack[:len(stack)-1]
		if closure[x] {
			continue
		}
		closure[x] = true
		for _, o := range x.outs {
			stack = append(stack, o)
		}
	}
	// Topologically sort the closure, dependencies first.
	var order []*cell
	seen := map[*cell]bool{}
	var build func(*cell)
	build = func(x *cell) {
		if seen[x] {
			return
		}
		seen[x] = true
		for _, d := range x.deps {
			if closure[d] {
				build(d)
			}
		}
		order = append(order, x)
	}
	for x := range closure {
		build(x)
	}
	// Recompute each affected cell once, in dependency order.
	changed := map[*cell]bool{c: true}
	for _, x := range order {
		if x.compute == nil {
			continue
		}
		vals := make([]int, len(x.deps))
		anyDepChanged := false
		for i, d := range x.deps {
			vals[i] = d.value
			anyDepChanged = anyDepChanged || changed[d]
		}
		if !anyDepChanged {
			continue
		}
		newValue := x.compute(vals)
		if newValue == x.value {
			continue
		}
		x.value = newValue
		changed[x] = true
		for _, cb := range x.callbacks {
			cb.callback(newValue)
		}
	}
}
</parameter>
<parameter=old>
func (c *cell) propagate() {
	const (
		unvisited = iota
		inProgress
		done
	)
	state := map[*cell]int{}
	var order []*cell
	var visit func(*cell)
	visit = func(x *cell) {
		switch state[x] {
		case unvisited:
			state[x] = inProgress
			for _, o := range x.outs {
				visit(o)
			}
			state[x] = done
			order = append(order, x)
		}
	}
	visit(c)
	for _, x := range order {
		if x.compute == nil {
			continue
		}
		vals := make([]int, len(x.deps))
		for i, d := range x.deps {
			vals[i] = d.value
		}
		newValue := x.compute(vals)
		if newValue == x.value {
			continue
		}
		x.value = newValue
		for _, cb := range x.callbacks {
			cb.callback(newValue)
		}
	}
}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
